data.whoSubtitle: Microsoft 365 is ideal for organizations that need secure communication, structured collaboration, and flexible productivity tools without managing complex IT infrastructure.

toolsCards.title: Outlook
toolsCards.desc: Enterprise-grade business email with custom domain setup, advanced spam filtering, shared calendars, mailbox management, and seamless access across desktop and mobile devices.

toolsCards.title: Microsoft Teams
toolsCards.desc: A unified workspace for messaging, voice calls, video conferencing, file sharing, and internal collaboration — designed to keep teams connected in real time.

toolsCards.title: OneDrive for Business
toolsCards.desc: Secure personal and shared cloud storage with file synchronization, version control, permission management, and reliable access from any location.

toolsCards.title: SharePoint
toolsCards.desc: Centralized document management and collaboration platform for creating team sites, internal portals, and structured file repositories.

toolsCards.title: Word, Excel & PowerPoint
toolsCards.desc: Industry-standard productivity apps for creating professional documents, data-driven spreadsheets, and impactful presentations with real-time collaboration.

toolsCards.title: Microsoft Exchange Online
toolsCards.desc: Reliable and scalable email infrastructure supporting Outlook with high availability, data protection, and compliance-ready architecture.

toolsCards.title: Microsoft Defender
toolsCards.desc: Integrated security layer protecting users and data from phishing attempts, malware, ransomware, and other email and endpoint threats.

toolsCards.title: Microsoft Entra ID
toolsCards.desc: Identity and access management system enabling secure sign-ins, role-based access, and multi-factor authentication across all Microsoft services.

toolsCards.title: Microsoft Intune
toolsCards.desc: Centralized device and application management for enforcing security policies and protecting business data on company and personal devices.

toolsCards.title: Power BI
toolsCards.desc: Advanced analytics and reporting capabilities that transform business data into interactive dashboards and actionable insights.

toolsCards.title: Power Automate
toolsCards.desc: Workflow automation tools that streamline approvals, notifications, and routine processes across Microsoft and third-party applications.

toolsCards.title: Forms
toolsCards.desc: Simple yet powerful form creation for surveys, internal assessments, customer feedback, and structured data collection.

toolsCards.title: Planner & To Do
toolsCards.desc: Task management tools that help teams plan projects, assign responsibilities, track progress, and manage daily work priorities.

toolsCards.title: Loop
toolsCards.desc: Flexible collaborative components that allow teams to co-create content instantly across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 apps.

toolsCards.title: Viva
toolsCards.desc: Employee experience applications focused on communication, learning, insights, and engagement within the digital workplace.
